title: Factorized layer-mask Mirror codes
hypothesis: On a planted two-factor mask family, Mirror factor coordinates on a fixed random backbone will compose held-out task-factor x layer-factor pairs with test normalized MSE <=0.05 while saving at least 20% actual payload bytes versus Piggyback task masks and at least 10% versus a shared-factor direct coefficient control. On unrelated task masks, quality should reveal where private masks are required.
physical_object: fixed random two-layer ReLU network represented as 64x64 weight matrices with 25% active edges
mirror_coordinate: factorized mask modulation of per-layer and per-task latent coordinates; rank-2 factor interaction
logical_multiplicity: held-out combinations of 8 task factors and 8 layer factors, with six trained pairs; separate unrelated stress bank
controls: shared dense random backbone, no mask
Piggyback independent binary mask per seen task-layer pair
factorized direct real-valued task x layer rank-2 coefficient bank plus same private fallback
factorized Mirror task/layer codes on a rank-2 mask basis plus same private fallback
independent binary mask upper control per evaluated task-layer pair

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: fixed-timestamp ZIP of sorted NPY arrays
storage.private_rule: validation nMSE > 0.05 stores a per-pair Piggyback mask for shared-factor methods

gates.promising: Across all 3 fresh seeds, held-out factor-pair max test nMSE <=0.05; Mirror payload <=0.80x Piggyback and <=0.90x direct rank-2 coefficients; no more private fallbacks than direct control.
gates.fail: Mirror max test nMSE >0.05 in >=2 fresh seeds, or Mirror payload >= Piggyback in >=2 seeds, or Mirror >= direct control in >=2 seeds.
gates.not_established: serialization/hash replay mismatch, split leakage, or controls cannot be reconstructed

boundaries: small synthetic random-feature network, fixed random teacher and oracle factors
post-fit/no optimizer training; this is not continual-learning capacity
four held-out combinations are a task-quality test, not a capacity count
no GPU runtime or natural multi-task benchmark claim
